name: Pass 27 production handoff bundle validation
goal: Ensure production handoff evidence proves the actual outage drill records it references.
risks: A production handoff could reference an outage drill ID without providing the drill file
A provided drill could belong to a different release or refinery gate
Runbook replay evidence could be unrelated to the referenced outage drill

nodes.label: Pass 27 bundle evidence critic review

node_contract.what: Review whether pass 26 production handoff evidence can be spoofed by unverified drill references.
node_contract.why: Original requirements demand evidence, not decorative cross-references.
node_contract.how: Inspect production handoff validator, fixtures, and runner for cross-file bundle checks.
node_contract.who: Codex using SRE, traceability, and verification expert lenses.
node_contract.how_good: Every finding becomes executable validation or an explicit residual risk.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any broken cross-record proof becomes validator logic and a hardening-runner fixture.

nodes.label: Production handoff bundle validator implementation

node_contract.what: Require production handoffs to validate against actual referenced outage drill records.
node_contract.why: Referenced operational records must match release, gate, operator, approver, and replay evidence.
node_contract.how: Add --outage-drill parsing, cross-file ID/release/gate/operator/replay checks, and negative fixtures.
node_contract.where: Installed and workspace df-production-sre-handoff validators plus runner.
node_contract.when: After critic review and before verification closure.
node_contract.how_good: Bundled handoff passes; unbundled and mismatched bundles fail.

nodes.feedback_loop: Rerun the full hardening suite after every bundle-validation change.

nodes.label: Pass 27 verification sweep

node_contract.why: Bundle-validation hardening only counts if the full suite and merged records pass.
node_contract.how: Run hardening suite, merged-record validation, hash sync, JSON, ASCII, and artifact ID checks.
node_contract.where: Workspace validation suite and pass 27 records.
node_contract.when: After all fixes and records are written.
node_contract.how_good: All checks pass and residual risks remain explicit.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any failed check reopens the fix node.
